Nonrenewal: 45 days written notice. Note: Endt #5 (PP 00 H107) at Pg 69 sets 20-day nonpayment notice but is overridden in AZ by Endt #32.

endorsements.name: Updated Suite of Employment-Related Risk Management Resources (Hartford Help/Jackson Lewis hotline)
endorsements.notes: Risk management services notice — EPLI value-add. Jackson Lewis hotline 866-620-0014.

endorsements.notes: Master Dec page.

endorsements.name: Crime Coverage Part Declarations
endorsements.notes: Crime Dec — $2M limits across most insuring agreements; $15K Deception Fraud / Social Engineering sublimit (LOW).

endorsements.name: Common Terms and Conditions
endorsements.notes: Master common terms governing all coverage parts.

endorsements.name: Directors, Officers and Entity Liability Coverage Part
endorsements.notes: D&O coverage form. Entity Liability included. Side A/B/C structure.

endorsements.notes: EPLI coverage form.

endorsements.notes: Fiduciary coverage form.

endorsements.name: Books and Records Request Endorsement
endorsements.notes: Endt #1. Adds D&O Insuring Agreement (D) Derivative Demands coverage for Books and Records Costs (e.g., Delaware Section 220 demand). $500,000 sublimit, part of (not in addition to) Investigation Costs sublimit.

endorsements.name: Disclosure/Cap on Losses — Terrorism Risk Insurance Act (TRIA)
endorsements.notes: Endt #2. Standard TRIA disclosure with $100B annual cap on insurer liability for certified acts of terrorism.

endorsements.name: Inquiry Costs Extension (Common Terms and Conditions)
endorsements.notes: Endt #3. Applies to D&O, EPL, and Fiduciary. Pays Inquiry Costs (written request to interview/depose Insured Person or produce documents). $50,000 sublimit aggregate, part of (not in addition to) Combined Aggregate Limit. Insured must elect to give notice.

endorsements.name: Amend Application Section — Delete Human Resources Reference
endorsements.notes: Endt #4. Limits imputation of knowledge in the Application to CEO/CFO of Named Entity or signer of Application — narrows imputation.

endorsements.name: Amend Cancellation Provision — 20 Days Notice / Unearned Premium Pro Rata
endorsements.notes: Endt #5. Insurer may cancel only for non-payment with 20 days notice. No other cancellation by Insurer permitted. Unearned premium pro rata. (Overridden by AZ Endt #32 — 10 days.)

endorsements.name: Amend Defense and Settlement Endorsement — Within Retention
endorsements.notes: Endt #6. Insureds may settle a Claim entirely within the retention without insurer consent. Insurer not liable for amounts within retention.

endorsements.name: Amend Definition of Damages — Include Personal Asset Protection Costs
endorsements.notes: Endt #7. Damages now includes Personal Asset Protection Costs incurred by President/CEO/CFO of Named Entity to oppose enforcement-authority efforts to seize personal assets/real estate.

endorsements.name: Amend Definition of Entity Claim — Include Coverage for Administrative or Regulatory Proceedings
endorsements.notes: Endt #8. Entity Claim now includes formal administrative/regulatory proceeding against Insured Entity, but ONLY while such proceeding is also pending against an Insured Person.

endorsements.name: Amend Definition of Manager — Include Shadow Director
endorsements.notes: Endt #9. Manager now includes de facto or shadow directors acting on behalf of Insured Entity with written indemnification agreement. Important for PE-backed company where PE sponsor representatives may be deemed shadow directors.

endorsements.name: Amend Definition of Notice Manager - Listed
endorsements.notes: Endt #10. Notice Manager limited to CEO and CFO of Named Entity. Narrows who can trigger notice obligations.

endorsements.name: Amend Definition of Subsidiary — Add Controlled 501(c)(3) Organizations
endorsements.notes: Endt #11. Subsidiary now includes foundations, charitable trusts, PACs, or 501(c)(3) organizations controlled by Named Entity or Subsidiary.

endorsements.name: Amend Notice of Claim — Section VI(B)(2) (EPLI)
endorsements.notes: Endt #12. EPL notice of claim period extended to 365 days after renewal date if policy is renewed with insurer.

endorsements.name: Amended Definition of Retaliation (EPLI)
endorsements.notes: Endt #13. Broadens Retaliation to expressly include workers' comp rights, FMLA, ERISA, ADA, refusing to violate law, cooperating with investigations, whistleblower claims (False Claims Act, SOX). Important for whistleblower scenarios.

endorsements.name: Amended Personal Profit Exclusion — Sections 11, 12, and 15 (D&O)
endorsements.notes: Endt #14. Personal profit exclusion now triggered only by judgment or non-appealable final adjudication. Carve-back for Securities Act §§11, 12, 15 violations. Favorable to insureds.

endorsements.name: Amended Retention Waiver (EPLI)
endorsements.notes: Endt #15. Retention does not apply to Defense Costs in covered Claims. Insurer reimburses 50% of Defense Costs paid within retention if final adjudication establishes none of Insureds liable other than Defense Costs.

endorsements.name: Anti Trust/Unfair Trade Exclusion — Sublimit (D&O)
endorsements.notes: Endt #16. Antitrust/Sherman/Clayton/FTC violations subject to sublimit of lesser of remaining limit or $1,000,000. Carve-back from total exclusion to sublimited coverage.

endorsements.name: Amend Definition of Damages — 502(c) (Fiduciary)
endorsements.notes: Endt #17. ERISA §502(c) penalties (failure to provide required ERISA plan documents) covered up to $250,000.

endorsements.name: COBRA Claim Sublimit Endorsement (Fiduciary)
endorsements.notes: Endt #18. Adds COBRA Claim coverage with $1,000,000 sublimit, $0 retention, prior/pending date 8/18/2023. Sublimit part of, not in addition to, Fiduciary Limit.

endorsements.name: EXCLUSION FOR MANUFACTURING AND PROFESSIONAL SERVICE ENDORSEMENT (D&O)
endorsements.notes: Endt #19. CRITICAL EXCLUSION — bars D&O coverage for any Claim based upon, arising from, or in any way related to: (1) malfunction of any product or product failure due to deficiency/inadequacy/defect/dangerous condition in product or its design/manufacture; or (2) rendering or failure to render any services for fees (including services for customers/clients). Carve-backs: (i) civil proceedings brought by security holders without solicitation/assistance/active participation of Insured Entity or Manager; or (ii) Derivative Action or Derivative Demand. Section V Insuring Agreement (C) sub-paragraph (C) deleted.

endorsements.name: Extended Reporting Period — 90 Day Election Period
endorsements.notes: Endt #20. ERP election period extended to 90 days after cancellation/non-renewal. Favorable.

endorsements.name: Forgery or Alteration — Personal Accounts (Crime)
endorsements.notes: Endt #21. Crime IA #2 extended to forgery/alteration of written instruments from personal accounts of each officer of Insured Entity. Sublimit lesser of 10% of IA-2 limit or $100,000. Retention 10% of IA-2 retention. Sublimit part of (not in addition to) IA-2 limit.

endorsements.name: Immigration Claim Coverage Endorsement With Defense Cost Sublimit (EPLI)
endorsements.notes: Endorsement #22. Adds Immigration Claim Defense coverage under EPLI. Sub-limit $100,000 (defense costs only — part of, not in addition to, EPLI aggregate). Retention $10,000. Prior/Pending 8/18/2023. Covers civil/criminal investigations re Immigration Control Act of 1986. Excludes labor/grievance arbitrations.

endorsements.name: Independent Contractor Extension With Indemnification Requirement (D&O)
endorsements.notes: Endorsement #23. Extends D&O Manager definition to natural-person Independent Contractors only if Insured Entity agrees to indemnify in same manner as Managers. Conditional on indemnification agreement.

endorsements.name: Liberalization Endorsement (Including Exceptions)
endorsements.notes: Endorsement #24. Standard liberalization clause — broader new-business AZ form auto-applies after Approval Date. Does not apply to terms modified by other endorsements (incl. state amendatory).

endorsements.name: Multiple Extended Reporting Period Options
endorsements.notes: Endorsement #25. Replaces ITEM 7 ERP options. Three tiers: (1) 12 mo @ 150% premium; (2) 24 mo @ 175% premium; (3) 36 mo @ 200% premium. ERP for Liability Coverage Parts only — NOT Non-Liability.

endorsements.name: Order of Payments (Fiduciary Liability)
endorsements.notes: Endorsement #26. Order of Payments for Fiduciary Coverage Part. Insurer pays IA (A) Insured Person Loss FIRST. Side A first protection.

endorsements.name: Personal Crisis Management & Reputation Expense Coverage (D&O)
endorsements.notes: Endorsement #27. Adds Personal Crises Management Expense Coverage to D&O. Pays PR fees/expenses (Insurer prior consent) for Personal Regulatory Event. $100,000 aggregate sub-limit — part of, NOT in addition to, D&O Aggregate. Must be reported within 60 days.

endorsements.name: Prior Acts Exclusion (Liability Coverage Parts)
endorsements.notes: Endorsement #28. MATERIAL EXCLUSION. Excludes Claims based upon/arising from/related to any Wrongful Act prior to 8/18/2023, or Interrelated Wrongful Acts thereto. Applies to D&O, EPLI AND Fiduciary. Effectively a 1-year prior acts cutoff (policy effective 8/18/2024). Significant for PE-backed company.

endorsements.name: Single Retention — Claims Covered Under Multiple Coverage Parts
endorsements.notes: Endorsement #29. Replaces Common Terms VI(D). When a Claim triggers multiple Coverage Parts, only the HIGHEST applicable Retention applies — no stacking. Insured-favorable.

endorsements.name: Telephone and Toll Fraud Coverage Endorsement (Crime)
endorsements.notes: Endorsement #30. Adds Telephone System Access Fraud IA to Crime. Limit: lesser of $1,000,000 or Crime IA #1 limit. Retention: lesser of $10,000 or Crime IA #1 retention. Loss capped to 30 consecutive days from discovery. Excludes losses from calling card / phone access card / phone credit card.

endorsements.name: Workplace Violence Coverage Endorsement (EPLI)
endorsements.notes: Endorsement #31. Adds Workplace Violence IA to EPLI ($100K sublimit per Dec). Pays BI Expenses up to 90 days, Employee salary/wages up to 90 days, counseling, security guard up to 30 days, security consultant, PR firm. NO Retention. EXCLUDES war/insurrection/riot AND extortion-driven force AND legal costs/attorneys' fees/settlements/judgments — EXPENSE-only coverage, NOT third-party liability.

endorsements.name: Arizona Cancellation and Nonrenewal Endorsement
endorsements.notes: Endorsement #32. AZ-mandatory amendatory. Insurer may ONLY cancel for nonpayment — 10 days written notice by certified mail. Nonrenewal: 45 days written notice by certified mail. Notice must include refund of unearned premium (except financed).

endorsements.name: Co-Defendant(s) Extension Endorsement — Private Equity or Venture Capital Funds
endorsements.notes: Endorsement #33. PE-SPECIFIC — IMPORTANT for Run-Test as PE-backed. Applies to D&O, EPLI, Fiduciary. Named Co-Defendants: Lincoln Shields, LLC and Black Mountain Investment Company, LLC. Defines Affiliated Entities (pooled investment vehicles, GP/managing entities, SPVs) and Co-Defendants. Coverage requires (i) actual/alleged Wrongful Act of an Insured, (ii) Claim first against Insured, (iii) Co-Defendants joined by reason of ownership/management control of Named Entity, (iv) same counsel. Coverage terminates if co-defendants dismissed/found not liable. NO coverage for Wrongful Acts of any Co-Defendant itself.

endorsements.name: Amended Declarations — Split Prior or Pending Date (Liability Coverage Parts)
endorsements.notes: Endorsement #34. Splits Prior or Pending Date for D&O / Entity Liability: 04/02/2024 applies ONLY to the additional/increased $1,000,000 layer in excess of the first $1,000,000. First $1M has older P&P date; upper $1M has 4/2/2024 P&P date. MATERIAL — narrower coverage on upper $1M layer for matters pending between 8/18/2023 and 4/2/2024.

endorsements.name: U.S. Dept. of Treasury OFAC Advisory Notice to Policyholders
endorsements.notes: Informational notice — not coverage modification.

endorsements.name: Producer Compensation Notice
endorsements.notes: Informational notice — Hartford producer compensation disclosures.

exclusions_of_note.name: Manufacturing and Professional Services Exclusion (D&O)
exclusions_of_note.impact: CRITICAL — bars D&O entity-liability coverage for any claim arising from product malfunction/defect or rendering/failure to render any services for fees (including services for customers/clients). For Run-Test, an election technology vendor whose CORE BUSINESS is rendering printing/mailing/processing services to counties, this exclusion could bar D&O coverage for the most likely claim scenarios — county suing for negligent service delivery, election errors, mail-handling failures. Carve-backs only for: (i) securities-holder civil proceedings brought without solicitation/assistance/active participation of Insured Entity or Manager; and (ii) Derivative Actions or Derivative Demands. Aligns with 2026-03-24 lesson learned — Hartford Private Choice Premier consistently has this exclusion. SEVERE GAP for Run-Test's operational risk profile (potential UGLY for Side C).

exclusions_of_note.name: Prior Acts Exclusion (D&O, EPLI, Fiduciary)
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes any Claim based upon/arising from/related to any Wrongful Act prior to 8/18/2023, or Interrelated Wrongful Acts thereto. Applies to D&O, EPLI AND Fiduciary. With policy effective 8/18/2024, this is a 1-year prior-acts window — historical exposures predating 8/18/2023 are uninsured. Especially material for PE-backed company per CLAUDE.md.

exclusions_of_note.name: Split Prior or Pending Date — D&O Increased Limit Layer
exclusions_of_note.impact: Upper $1,000,000 D&O / Entity Liability layer (in excess of first $1M) has Prior or Pending Date of 4/2/2024. Any litigation/proceeding pending on or before 4/2/2024 not covered by upper $1M, even if covered by first $1M. Creates a coverage 'donut' for matters pending between 8/18/2023 and 4/2/2024.

exclusions_of_note.name: Antitrust / Unfair Trade Exclusion (D&O) — Sublimited
exclusions_of_note.impact: Antitrust/Sherman/Clayton/FTC claims sublimited to lesser of remaining limit or $1,000,000. Better than full exclusion (carve-back exists) but still capped.

exclusions_of_note.name: Personal Profit Exclusion (D&O) — Final Adjudication Required
exclusions_of_note.impact: Favorable — personal profit exclusion only triggered by judgment or non-appealable final adjudication. Carve-back for Securities Act §§11, 12, 15 violations.

exclusions_of_note.name: D&O — Bodily Injury / Property Damage Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes BI/PD/sickness/disease/emotional distress/property damage. Standard D&O exclusion. Carve-back for: (i) security holder civil proceedings; (ii) Derivative Action/Demand; (iii) corporate manslaughter/homicide criminal proceedings.

exclusions_of_note.name: D&O — Pollution Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes pollution-related Claims. Carve-back for Insuring Agreement A (Side A — non-indemnifiable Insured Person Loss) and security-holder civil proceedings / Derivative Actions.

exclusions_of_note.name: D&O — Wage & Hour / ERISA / Equal Pay / WARN / COBRA Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: D&O does not cover wage & hour, unpaid wages, WC benefits, unemployment, disability, social security, Equal Pay Act, WARN, COBRA. Wage & Hour defense costs separately sublimited under EPLI ($100K). Exposure risk for hourly election-services workforce.

exclusions_of_note.name: D&O — ERISA Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: ERISA-related claims excluded from D&O — covered instead under Fiduciary Liability ($1M).

exclusions_of_note.name: D&O — Insured vs. Insured Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes Claims by/on behalf of Insureds or security holders. Carve-backs for security-holder derivative proceedings, Derivative Actions/Demands, Employee Insured Person Claims (without Manager assistance), wrongful-termination Manager Claims, and Whistleblower-related claims.

exclusions_of_note.name: D&O — Outside Capacity / Other Entity Service Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes Insured Person Claims based on service as director/officer/trustee/employee of any entity other than an Insured Entity, even at Insured Entity's direction. Carve-back only for Insured Persons serving in an 'Outside Capacity' as defined.

exclusions_of_note.name: D&O — Outside Entity Insured-vs-Insured Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Bars Claims by/on behalf of Outside Entities or their D&Os against Insured Persons serving in Outside Capacity. Carve-backs for derivative actions and contribution/indemnification.

exclusions_of_note.name: D&O — Public Offering / Securities Listing Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes Claims arising from any public listing/offering of Insured Entity securities or post-offering purchase/sale. Carve-backs for private placements (incl. JOBS Act crowdfunding), failure-to-IPO suits by security holders, and pre-IPO Wrongful Acts where the offering does not occur.

exclusions_of_note.name: D&O — Conduct Exclusions (Personal Profit, Fraud)
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes Loss for personal financial profit/remuneration the Insured was not legally entitled to, and for criminal/deliberately fraudulent acts or willful violations of law — both require final non-appealable adjudication. Wrongful Act of one Insured not imputed to others. For Entity Coverage (C), only triggered if past/present CEO, CFO, GC or equivalent of Named Entity committed the act.

exclusions_of_note.name: D&O Insuring Agreement (C) Entity Coverage — Contract Liability Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes Entity Loss arising from contractual liability except where liability would attach absent the contract; carve-back for security-holder civil proceedings and derivative actions/demands.

exclusions_of_note.name: D&O Insuring Agreement (C) — Employment Practices Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes Entity Loss for employment-related Wrongful Acts, discrimination, sexual harassment — those flow to EPLI part instead.

exclusions_of_note.name: D&O Insuring Agreement (C) — Bodily Injury / Personal Injury Type Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes false arrest, abuse of process, malicious prosecution, defamation, invasion of privacy, trespass, nuisance, wrongful entry/eviction, assault, battery, loss of consortium under Entity Coverage.

exclusions_of_note.name: D&O Insuring Agreement (C) — IP Infringement Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes Entity Loss for copyright/patent/trademark/trade dress/service mark/trade secret/IP infringement, dilution, misappropriation. Carve-back for security-holder civil proceedings and derivative actions/demands.

exclusions_of_note.name: D&O Insuring Agreement (C) — Antitrust / FTC / Unfair Trade Practices Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes Entity Loss for unfair trade practices or violation of FTC Act or similar laws.

exclusions_of_note.name: D&O Insuring Agreement (C) — Inadequate Consideration Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Bars indemnity for Entity-purchase-of-its-own-securities at inadequate consideration, but Defense Costs are carved back.

exclusions_of_note.name: EPLI — Bodily Injury / Property Damage Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes BI/PD/sickness/disease/death and false imprisonment, abuse of process, malicious prosecution, trespass, nuisance, wrongful eviction. Carve-back for employment-related defamation/misrepresentation and employment-related mental anguish/false arrest/invasion of privacy when alleged with covered EPL Wrongful Act.

exclusions_of_note.name: EPLI — Wage & Hour, ERISA, OSHA, NLRA, COBRA, WARN Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes claims for unpaid wages/overtime, WC, unemployment, disability, social security, plus violations of WARN, NLRA, OSHA, COBRA, ERISA, and Wage & Hour Violations. Carve-back: Defense Costs only for Wage & Hour, subject to a Sub-Limit per Item 5 Decs (sub-limit erodes the aggregate).

exclusions_of_note.name: EPLI — Strike / Lockout / Labor Dispute Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes lockout, strike, picket line, replacement-worker, and similar labor-dispute or collective-bargaining actions.

exclusions_of_note.name: EPLI — Contractual Liability Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes liability assumed under contract; carve-back for liability that would attach absent contract. Separate sub-section also excludes breach of oral/written/implied employment contract with Defense-Cost carve-back.

exclusions_of_note.name: EPLI Insuring Agreement (B) — Antitrust / Price Discrimination Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Bars Third-Party Liability for antitrust/price discrimination/unfair-competition claims.

exclusions_of_note.name: Immigration Claim — Defense Costs Only, $100K Sub-limit
exclusions_of_note.impact: Immigration claim coverage is DEFENSE COSTS ONLY (no indemnity). $100K aggregate sub-limit is part of, NOT in addition to, EPLI Aggregate — erodes EPLI limit. $10K retention applies. Prior/Pending Date 8/18/2023.

exclusions_of_note.name: Fiduciary — Pollution Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes pollution-related claims; carve-back where Claim alleges loss to Insured Plan or participant accounts caused by pollution event.

exclusions_of_note.name: Fiduciary — Wage & Hour / Equal Pay / WARN Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes claims for unpaid wages/overtime, WC, unemployment, disability, Equal Pay Act, WARN Act, and Wage & Hour Violations under fiduciary part.

exclusions_of_note.name: Fiduciary — Failure to Pay Benefits Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes claims for actual/alleged failure to pay benefits owed under an Insured Plan; carve-backs for personal-obligation Insured Person liability and for plan-investment-loss claims regardless of how characterized.

exclusions_of_note.name: Fiduciary — Failure to Fund / Reversion Exclusion
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes failure to fund/collect contributions and any reversion of plan contributions/assets to Insured Entity.

exclusions_of_note.name: Fiduciary — Personal Profit / Fraud Conduct Exclusions
exclusions_of_note.impact: Personal profit and criminal/fraudulent act exclusions, both requiring final non-appealable adjudication. Wrongful Act not imputed across Insureds.

exclusions_of_note.name: Crime — Limit & Retention Single-Highest-Retention Rule / Virtual Currency Sublimit
exclusions_of_note.impact: If multiple Retentions could apply to one Occurrence, only the HIGHEST applies. Virtual Currency sublimit $15,000 / Retention $5,000 per Occurrence — significantly limits crypto-related Crime recovery.

exclusions_of_note.name: Crime — Acts Committed By Insured's Partners or Limited Liability Members
exclusions_of_note.impact: Excludes loss from theft/deception fraud/forgery committed by partners or LLC members. As an LLC, Runbeck's LLC-member-perpetrated crime is excluded except limited carve-back for IA 1 (Employee Theft) and IA 2 (Forgery) subject to LLC-member-as-Employee paragraph (10) calculation.

exclusions_of_note.name: Crime — Voluntary Parting of Title or Possession (IA 3 & 4 only)
exclusions_of_note.impact: Loss from voluntary parting via dishonest inducement excluded under Inside Premises and Outside Premises (IA 3 & 4). Does NOT affect Deception Fraud (social engineering) IA.

exclusions_of_note.name: Crime — Indirect Loss
exclusions_of_note.impact: Loss of income / business interruption from a Crime occurrence is excluded. Compensatory damages directly from a covered loss are payable.

exclusions_of_note.name: Crime — Intellectual Property, Confidential Information, Electronic Data
exclusions_of_note.impact: No coverage for theft/disclosure of trade secrets, IP, credit card numbers, bank account numbers, etc. (unless covered under IA 8 Identity Recovery), or Data (unless covered under IA 7). For Run-Test handling 90M voter records, this is a meaningful gap — voter PII theft would NOT be a Crime claim, must be addressed by Cyber policy.

exclusions_of_note.name: Crime — Inventory Shortages
exclusions_of_note.impact: Standard exclusion — loss based solely on inventory computation is barred.

exclusions_of_note.name: Crime — War / Nuclear / Governmental Action
exclusions_of_note.impact: Standard catastrophic exclusions.

exclusions_of_note.name: Crime — Deception Fraud sub-exclusions
exclusions_of_note.impact: Deception Fraud (social engineering) IA carved out from many other coverages (no double-recovery between Funds Transfer Fraud, Computer Fraud, Forgery, etc.). Deception Fraud sublimit only $15,000 (LOW) per Crime Dec — very limited social engineering protection.

exclusions_of_note.name: Crime — Identity Recovery: Professional/Business Identity Theft Excluded
exclusions_of_note.impact: IA 8 Identity Recovery is for the personal identities of named officers/directors/risk managers/in-house counsel — not the business itself.

exclusions_of_note.name: Workplace Violence — No Third-Party Liability
exclusions_of_note.impact: Workplace Violence coverage is EXPENSE coverage only (BI, employee, PR firm). Endorsement EXPLICITLY excludes 'any legal costs, attorneys fees, expenses, settlements, judgments, penalties or other amounts incurred as a result of any claim, suit or other legal proceeding brought against an Insured in connection with a Workplace Violence Action.' Third-party bodily injury / wrongful death suits flowing from a workplace shooting would NOT be covered here — must be evaluated under GL/Umbrella/EPLI third-party harassment provisions.

exclusions_of_note.name: Workplace Violence — War/Civil Unrest and Extortion Carve-outs
exclusions_of_note.impact: Workplace Violence Expenses excluded for war/invasion/insurrection/riot/rebellion/revolution/civil war/military action AND for use or threat of force occurring for purpose of demanding money/securities/property (i.e., extortion-driven violence falls under Crime/K&R coverage, not WPV).

exclusions_of_note.name: Telephone & Toll Fraud — Calling/Credit Card Carve-out and 30-Day Cap
exclusions_of_note.impact: Toll-fraud coverage excludes loss from use of calling card, telephone access card, or telephone credit card. Loss capped to 30 consecutive days from first discovery — material limitation for slow-rolling toll fraud.
